title: Transport of one Proj twist along any chart comparison
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $S=k[x_0,x_1]$ carry its total-degree grading, let $P=\operatorname{Proj}S$ [def-nagata-affine-proj], and let $C:P\cong\mathbf P^1_k$ be a chart-compatible scheme isomorphism [def-sc-p1-proj-chart-isomorphism], with the standard chart convention of [def-sc-p1-standard]. For every integer $d$, the inverse pullback of the associated Proj twist [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf] satisfies $(C^{-1})^*\operatorname{Proj.twist}(d)\cong\operatorname{ProjectiveSpace.twist}(d)$, where the latter is the inverse image of the integral-model twist [def-pc-projective-space-twist]. This assertion concerns one rank-one twist and assumes no auxiliary graded module, basis or supplied sheaf.

proof.text: Construct TwistData for the integral-model projective-space twist using the proved standard-generator theorem. This construction works for every integer d, including zero and negative d.

The shifted-free twist theorem supplies a chart-compatible comparison C prime, a module L prime with TwistData, and an isomorphism from the Proj twist to its tensor pullback. The variable basic opens cover polynomial Proj: apply iSup_basicOpen_eq_top prime and adjoin_range_X_eq_top, then lift the index to ULift(Fin 2). The linearCover hom_ext lemma and the two chart_eq fields give C prime.iso.hom = C.iso.hom.

Apply exists_twistData_unique_iso to obtain a reference glued twist L zero. Its uniqueness clause gives isomorphisms L zero to L prime and L zero to the projective-space twist. Compose the inverse of the first with the second, yielding L prime isomorphic to the projective-space twist.

The tensor pullback and Scheme.Modules.pullback are left adjoints of the same module pushforward, so Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq identifies them. Compose the supplied Proj isomorphism with this identification, pull back the module isomorphism from the previous step, and replace C prime.iso.hom using its equality with C.iso.hom. Pull back along C.iso.inv, then apply pullbackComp, pullbackCongr for C.iso.inv_hom_id and pullbackId to cancel the two inverse scheme maps.

theorem proj_twist_inverse_transport (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (C : ProjectiveLine.ProjChartIsomorphism k) (d : ℤ) :
    Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.iso.inv).obj
      (twist (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) d) ≅
        ProjectiveSpace.twist (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (Spec (.of k)) d)
